note: Set A is better because it captures the scale for both the West Module (C1) and East Module (A1), whereas Set B misses the East Module scale entirely. Both sets suffer from significant duplication (extracting the same revision, elevation, and scale data multiple times with slight variations). Set A has a minor unit error ('ratio' for scale), while Set B mislabels section C1 as 'Drawing C1'. Set A's differentiation of floor height conditions by section is more faithful to the visual layout.
remarks: Both sets extract revision dates and descriptions as separate claims, inflating the count. Both extract Grade Level and Finished Floor elevations multiple times. Set A's inclusion of the East Module scale is the deciding factor for completeness.
